title: P1 — Paints, strokes and effects
exercises: the paint union, gradient transforms and stops, dashPattern, strokeWeight (uniform vs per-side), strokeAlign, strokeCap, strokeJoin, the effect union, blend modes
record: which effect types were available; noise may not be
notes: Gradients: two stops #364FC7 → #F08C00, gradientTransform identity [[1,0,0],[0,1,0]] for all four types.
P1b: fills bottom to top: solid #FA5252, linear gradient at 50 %, solid #4DABF7 with paint blend MULTIPLY; layer blend MULTIPLY.
P1c: half opacity = layer opacity 0.5; isolated group = group blend NORMAL (not PASS_THROUGH) whose top child blends MULTIPLY.
P1d per-side dashed: weights top 1, right 2, bottom 4, left 8; dash pattern [8, 4]. Caps on 100 px lines (weight 6); joins on zigzags (weight 8).
P1e: stroke weight 8, alignments inside / center / outside. P1f: linear gradient stroke, weight 6.
Effect types available on this build: drop shadow, inner shadow, layer blur, background blur, progressive blur, noise, texture, glass.
provenance: Authored for the Penumbra Figma interchange tests by scripts/figma-fixtures in a scratch Figma file; synthetic content only. Built by Penumbra scripts/figma-curate.
